school.tagged_body:
Daegu International Culture Festival
{{t:Travel around the world in our city!}}

Date: Saturday, October 31 – Sunday, November 1
Time: 11:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.
Place: Duryu Park, Daegu

Programs
- Food Street: {{g:Try food from 12 countries|명령문: 동사원형으로 시작 (~해 보세요)}}. You can eat Mexican tacos, Indian curry, and Turkish kebabs.
- Traditional Clothing Experience: Wear {{v:traditional}} clothes from Japan, Vietnam, and Mongolia. Take photos in them. (Free)
- World Music Stage: Enjoy live music {{g:every two hours|every + 숫자 + 복수명사: ~마다 (2시간마다)}}. The first show starts at {{v:noon}}. The last show starts at 4:00 p.m.
- Language Corner: {{g:Learn how to say hello|how to + 동사원형: ~하는 방법}} in five languages.

Tickets
- Adults: 8,000 won
- Students (ages 13–18): 5,000 won
- Children under 13: Free
※ Students {{g:must show|must + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 (의무)}} their student ID card at the {{v:entrance}}.

Special Event
Get stamps from {{v:five or more}} country {{v:booths}}. Then you can get a free festival T-shirt! (Only the first 300 visitors each day can get one.)

Please note: {{g:You cannot bring pets|cannot + 동사원형: ~할 수 없다 (금지)}} into the festival. Please bring your own cups and bags. You can use them {{v:again and again}}.

questions.q: What is the purpose of this notice?
choices: To teach people a new language
To tell people about a festival
To invite people to a school sports day
questions.answer: To tell people about a festival
questions.explanation: 축제의 날짜, 장소, 프로그램, 입장료를 알려 주는 축제 안내문이다.

questions.q: Where is the festival held?
questions.explanation: 'Place: Duryu Park, Daegu'와 일치한다.

questions.q: How many days does the festival last?
questions.explanation: 토요일(10월 31일)부터 일요일(11월 1일)까지 이틀 동안 열린다.

questions.q: What time does the festival close each day?
questions.explanation: 'Time: 11:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.'이므로 오후 6시에 끝난다.

questions.q: Which food is NOT mentioned on Food Street?
questions.explanation: 타코(멕시코), 커리(인도), 케밥(튀르키예)만 예로 나와 있다. 스시는 언급되지 않았다.

questions.q: Traditional clothes from which country are NOT mentioned?
choices: None of them; all are mentioned
questions.explanation: 일본, 베트남, 몽골의 전통 의상만 나온다.

questions.q: Which program says "(Free)" next to it?
questions.explanation: 전통 의상 체험 옆에 (Free)라고 쓰여 있다.

questions.q: When does the first music show start?
questions.explanation: 'The first show starts at noon.' noon은 낮 12시이다.

questions.q: How many music shows are there each day?
questions.explanation: 낮 12시에 시작해서 2시간마다 열리고 마지막 공연이 4시이므로 12시, 2시, 4시 세 번이다.

questions.q: What can you learn at the Language Corner?
choices: How to say hello in five languages
questions.answer: How to say hello in five languages
questions.explanation: 'Learn how to say hello in five languages.'

questions.q: How much is a ticket for a 15-year-old student?
What must students show at the entrance?
questions.explanation: 'Students must show their student ID card at the entrance.'

questions.q: How much does a 10-year-old child pay?
questions.explanation: 13세 미만 어린이는 무료(Free)이다.

questions.q: How can you get a free festival T-shirt?
choices: Get stamps from five or more country booths.
questions.answer: Get stamps from five or more country booths.
questions.explanation: 'Get stamps from five or more country booths. Then you can get a free festival T-shirt!'

questions.q: Which is NOT true about the festival?
choices: It is held at Duryu Park.
Children under 13 can enter for free.
You can take photos in traditional clothes.
questions.explanation: 'You cannot bring pets into the festival.' 애완동물은 데려올 수 없다.

questions.q: 다음 중 'entrance'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: entrance는 '입구'라는 뜻이다. 출구는 exit.

questions.q: 다음 중 'traditional'의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: traditional은 '전통적인'이라는 뜻이다. traditional clothes = 전통 의상.

questions.q: Minsu is 15 years old. He goes to the festival with his mother. How much do they pay in total?

items: Watch the last music show at 4:00 p.m.
Arrive when the festival opens at 11:00 a.m.
Leave when the festival closes at 6:00 p.m.
Watch the second music show at 2:00 p.m.
Watch the first music show at noon.
answer: Arrive when the festival opens at 11:00 a.m.
Watch the first music show at noon.
Watch the second music show at 2:00 p.m.
Watch the last music show at 4:00 p.m.
Leave when the festival closes at 6:00 p.m.

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 이 축제에서 할 수 있는 프로그램 네 가지를 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: ① 12개 나라의 음식 먹어 보기 ② 일본·베트남·몽골 전통 의상 입고 사진 찍기 ③ 라이브 음악 공연 보기 ④ 다섯 개 언어로 인사말 배우기
essays.rubric: 음식, 전통 의상, 음악 공연, 언어 인사말 네 가지를 모두 쓰면 만점, 세 가지면 부분 점수

essays.q: How can you get a free festival T-shirt? Answer in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: I need to get stamps from five or more country booths. I also have to be one of the first 300 visitors that day.
essays.rubric: ① 5개 이상 부스에서 도장 받기 ② 하루 선착순 300명, 완전한 영어 문장

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 엄마(어른), 나(15살 학생), 동생(9살)이 함께 축제에 가면 입장료는 모두 얼마인지 계산 과정과 함께 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 엄마 8,000원 + 나 5,000원 + 동생 0원(13세 미만 무료) = 모두 13,000원이다.
essays.rubric: ① 어른 8,000원 ② 학생 5,000원 ③ 13세 미만 무료 ④ 합계 13,000원

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오. '학생들은 입구에서 학생증을 보여 주어야 한다.' <조건> must를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Students must show their student ID card at the entrance.
essays.rubric: ① must + 동사원형 ② student ID card ③ at the entrance ④ 의미 일치

essays.q: Which program do you want to try most? Write the reason in 2 English sentences.
essays.sampleAnswer: I want to try the Food Street most. I love tacos, and I want to try food from many countries.
essays.rubric: ① 프로그램 이름 ② 이유 ③ 완전한 영어 문장 2개

academy.tagged_body:
Daegu International Culture Festival
{{t:Travel around the world without leaving the city!}}

Date: Saturday, October 31 – Sunday, November 1
Time: 11:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.
Place: Duryu Park, Daegu

Programs
- Food Street: Try {{v:dishes}} from 12 countries, {{g:including|including + 명사: ~을 포함하여}} Mexican tacos, Indian curry, and Turkish kebabs.
- Traditional Clothing Experience: Wear {{v:traditional}} clothes from Japan, Vietnam, and Mongolia and take photos. (Free)
- World Music Stage: Enjoy live {{v:performances}} {{g:every two hours, starting at noon|every + 숫자 + 복수명사(~마다) / 분사구문 starting(= and it starts)}}. The last show begins at 4:00 p.m.
- Language Corner: Learn basic {{v:greetings}} in five languages.

Tickets
- Adults: 8,000 won
- Students (ages 13–18): 5,000 won
- Children under 13: Free
※ Students {{g:must show|must + 동사원형: ~해야 한다}} their student ID card at the {{v:entrance}}.

Special Event
Collect stamps from {{v:at least}} five country booths and get a free festival T-shirt! (Only for the first 300 visitors each day)

Please note: {{g:Pets are not allowed|수동태 부정: be not + p.p. (~이 허용되지 않는다)}} inside the festival area. {{g:Visitors are encouraged to bring|be encouraged to + 동사원형: ~하도록 권장되다}} their own {{v:reusable}} cups and bags.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
choices: To explain how to cook food from 12 countries
To give information about a festival and invite people to it
To announce a new park in Daegu
To ask people to travel abroad
questions.answer: To give information about a festival and invite people to it
questions.explanation: 날짜·장소·프로그램·입장료를 안내하며 축제에 오라고 홍보하는 글이다.

questions.q: What does "Travel around the world without leaving the city!" mean?
choices: You can experience many cultures right in Daegu.
You can win a free trip to another country.
You must leave the city to enjoy the festival.
The festival moves to a different city each day.
You can buy cheap plane tickets at the festival.
questions.answer: You can experience many cultures right in Daegu.
questions.explanation: 도시를 떠나지 않고도 여러 나라의 음식·옷·음악·언어를 체험할 수 있다는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the notice?
choices: Visitors can try dishes from 12 countries.
The Traditional Clothing Experience is free.
The festival is held for three days.
Children under 13 do not need to pay.
questions.answer: The festival is held for three days.
questions.explanation: 토요일~일요일 이틀 동안 열린다.

questions.q: Which CANNOT be found in the notice?
choices: Whether there is a parking lot
The time of the last music show
The number of languages at the Language Corner
questions.answer: Whether there is a parking lot
questions.explanation: 주차장에 대한 정보는 안내문에 없다.

questions.q: Yuna arrives at the World Music Stage at 2:30 p.m. When can she watch the next show?
questions.explanation: 공연은 12시, 2시, 4시에 시작한다. 2시 30분 이후의 다음 공연은 4시이다.

questions.q: How many live performances are there during the whole festival?
questions.explanation: 하루 3번(12시, 2시, 4시) × 이틀 = 6번이다.

questions.q: Two parents go to the festival with their 16-year-old son and 11-year-old daughter. How much do they pay in total?
Which visitor is following the rules and tips of the festival?
choices: Sora brings her own reusable cup.
Tom brings his puppy to the Food Street.
Jiho, a student, pays 5,000 won but does not show his ID card.
Mina uses many paper cups and throws them away.
Leo tries to enter the festival at 7:00 p.m.
questions.answer: Sora brings her own reusable cup.
questions.explanation: 재사용 컵을 가져오는 것이 권장된다. 애완동물 금지, 학생증 제시 필수, 운영 시간은 오후 6시까지이다.

questions.q: Who will get a free festival T-shirt?
choices: Jun, the 50th visitor on Sunday, collected stamps from four booths.
Ara, the 350th visitor on Saturday, collected stamps from seven booths.
Ben bought an adult ticket but collected no stamps.
Eric, the 400th visitor on Sunday, collected stamps from five booths.
Hana, the 120th visitor on Saturday, collected stamps from six booths.
questions.answer: Hana, the 120th visitor on Saturday, collected stamps from six booths.
questions.explanation: 도장 5개 이상 + 그날 선착순 300명 안에 드는 두 조건을 모두 만족한 사람은 하나뿐이다.

questions.q: 'including Mexican tacos, Indian curry, and Turkish kebabs'에서 including의 의미는?
questions.explanation: including = ~을 포함하여. 12개국 음식 중 일부 예를 든 것이다.

questions.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'reusable'?
questions.explanation: re(다시) + use(사용하다) + able(~할 수 있는) = 다시 사용할 수 있는.

questions.q: 'Collect stamps from at least five country booths'의 의미로 알맞은 것은?
choices: 정확히 다섯 개 나라 부스에서만 도장을 모아라.
다섯 개보다 적은 부스에서 도장을 모아라.
다섯 개 나라 부스를 피해서 도장을 모아라.
최소 다섯 개 나라 부스에서 도장을 모아라.
questions.answer: 최소 다섯 개 나라 부스에서 도장을 모아라.
questions.explanation: at least = 적어도, 최소한. 5개 이상이면 된다.

questions.q: 'Visitors are encouraged to bring their own reusable cups and bags.'의 의미로 알맞은 것은?
choices: 방문객들은 반드시 컵과 가방을 사야 한다.
방문객들은 컵과 가방을 가져올 수 없다.
방문객들은 개인 재사용 컵과 가방을 가져오도록 권장된다.
방문객들은 축제에서 컵과 가방을 무료로 받는다.
questions.answer: 방문객들은 개인 재사용 컵과 가방을 가져오도록 권장된다.
questions.explanation: be encouraged to + 동사원형 = ~하도록 권장되다(의무가 아님).

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically INCORRECT?
choices: Students must show their student ID card.
Visitors are encouraged to bring their own cups.
Travel around the world without leaving the city.
Pets are not allow inside the festival area.
The last show begins at 4:00 p.m.
questions.answer: Pets are not allow inside the festival area.
questions.explanation: 수동태는 be + 과거분사이므로 allow → allowed.

questions.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "Travel around the world without ____ the city!"
questions.explanation: 전치사 without 뒤에는 동명사가 온다.

questions.q: What is the largest number of free T-shirts that can be given out during the festival?
questions.explanation: 하루 선착순 300명(each day) × 이틀 = 최대 600장이다.

questions.q: Jun can stay at the festival only from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. on Sunday. What can he do?
choices: He can watch the first music show.
He can watch three music shows.
He can watch the last music show.
He can enter the festival on Monday.
He can bring his cat with him.
questions.answer: He can watch the last music show.
questions.explanation: 3~5시 사이에는 4시 마지막 공연만 볼 수 있다.

questions.q: Ami wants to wear a kimono and take pictures. Which program should she choose?
questions.explanation: 일본 등의 전통 의상을 입고 사진을 찍는 프로그램은 Traditional Clothing Experience이다.

items: Visit country booths and collect stamps.
Get a free festival T-shirt.
Show your student ID card and buy a ticket at the entrance.
Collect stamps from at least five booths.
Enter the festival area.
answer: Show your student ID card and buy a ticket at the entrance.
Enter the festival area.
Visit country booths and collect stamps.
Collect stamps from at least five booths.
Get a free festival T-shirt.

essays.q: Explain in English what "Travel around the world without leaving the city!" means. Use at least two programs from the notice.
essays.sampleAnswer: It means that we can experience other cultures in Daegu. For example, we can try dishes from 12 countries and wear traditional clothes from Japan, Vietnam, and Mongolia.
essays.rubric: ① 도시 안에서 여러 문화 체험 ② 프로그램 2개 이상 예시 ③ 완전한 영어 문장

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 축제 기간 동안 무료 티셔츠를 받는 데 필요한 조건 두 가지를 쓰고, 축제 전체에서 최대 몇 장이 지급될 수 있는지 이유와 함께 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 조건: ① 최소 5개 나라 부스에서 도장을 모아야 한다. ② 그날 선착순 300명 안에 들어야 한다. 하루 300명씩 이틀이므로 최대 600장이다.
essays.rubric: ① 도장 5개 이상 ② 하루 선착순 300명 ③ 300 × 2일 = 600장

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '애완동물은 축제 장소 안에 허용되지 않는다.' <조건> allow를 수동태로 쓸 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Pets are not allowed inside the festival area.
essays.rubric: ① Pets are not ② allowed(과거분사) ③ inside the festival area ④ 의미 일치

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '방문객들은 자신의 재사용 컵을 가져오도록 권장된다.' <조건> encourage를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Visitors are encouraged to bring their own reusable cups.
essays.rubric: ① are encouraged(수동태) ② to bring ③ their own reusable cups ④ 의미 일치

essays.q: Write a short message in English to invite a friend to the festival. Include the date, the place, and one program you want to enjoy together.
essays.sampleAnswer: Hi, Jimin! Let's go to the Daegu International Culture Festival on Saturday, October 31. It is at Duryu Park. I want to try Indian curry with you at the Food Street. Don't forget your student ID card!

advanced.tagged_body:
Daegu International Culture Festival
{{t:Experience a journey around the globe without ever leaving the city!}}

Date: Saturday, October 31 – Sunday, November 1
Time: 11:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.
Place: Duryu Park, Daegu

Programs
- Food Street: {{v:Sample}} {{v:authentic}} dishes from 12 different countries, including Mexican tacos, Indian curry, and Turkish kebabs.
- Traditional Clothing Experience: Try on traditional {{v:costumes}} from Japan, Vietnam, and Mongolia, and {{v:capture the moment}} in photographs. (Free of charge)
- World Music Stage: Enjoy live {{g:performances held every two hours|과거분사 후치수식: held every two hours가 performances를 꾸밈}}, {{g:beginning at noon|분사구문: (and they begin) at noon}}. The final performance starts at 4:00 p.m.
- Language Corner: Learn basic greetings in five different languages.

Tickets
- Adults: 8,000 won
- Students (ages 13–18): 5,000 won
- Children under 13: Free admission
※ {{g:Students are required to present|be required to + 동사원형: ~해야 한다 / present = 제시하다}} their student ID card at the entrance.

Special Event
Collect stamps from at least five country booths {{g:to receive a complimentary festival T-shirt|to부정사 부사적 용법(목적·결과) / complimentary = 무료의}}! (Available only to the first 300 visitors each day)

Please note: {{g:Pets are not permitted|수동태 부정: be not permitted = 허용되지 않다}} inside the festival grounds. {{g:Visitors are strongly encouraged to bring|be encouraged to + 동사원형: ~하도록 권장되다}} their own reusable cups and shopping bags {{t:to reduce waste}}.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
choices: To recruit volunteers for a music performance
To report the results of a cultural event
To promote a multicultural festival and provide details for visitors
To advertise travel packages to 12 countries
To explain the history of traditional costumes
questions.answer: To promote a multicultural festival and provide details for visitors
questions.explanation: 다문화 축제를 홍보하고 일정·프로그램·요금·규칙을 안내하는 글이다.

questions.q: In the notice, 'complimentary' is closest in meaning to ____.
questions.explanation: complimentary = 무료의(free). compliment(칭찬)와 헷갈리지 않도록 한다.

questions.q: In "Students are required to present their student ID card," 'present' means ____.
questions.explanation: present가 동사로 쓰여 '제시하다, 보여 주다(show)'라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: Which word can best replace 'permitted'?
questions.explanation: permit = allow, 허용하다.

questions.q: What does 'Sample' mean in "Sample authentic dishes from 12 different countries"?
questions.explanation: 동사 sample = (음식을) 맛보다, 시식하다.

questions.q: Daniel arrives at the World Music Stage at 1:00 p.m. on Sunday and stays until the festival closes. How many performances can he watch?
questions.explanation: 공연은 12시, 2시, 4시에 시작한다. 1시에 도착하면 2시와 4시 공연, 두 번 볼 수 있다.

questions.q: A teacher brings four 14-year-old students and two 12-year-old children. How much do they pay in total?
What is the largest possible number of complimentary T-shirts given out during the festival?
questions.explanation: 하루 선착순 300명 × 이틀 = 최대 600장.

questions.q: Which visitor will receive a complimentary T-shirt?
choices: Max, the 310th visitor on Saturday, collected eight stamps.
Yeji, the 10th visitor on Saturday, collected four stamps.
Chris, the 299th visitor on Sunday, collected three stamps.
Sumi bought a ticket online but collected no stamps.
Rina, the 280th visitor on Sunday, collected five stamps.
questions.answer: Rina, the 280th visitor on Sunday, collected five stamps.
questions.explanation: 도장 5개 이상(at least five)과 그날 선착순 300명이라는 두 조건을 모두 충족한 사람은 Rina이다.

questions.q: Which question CANNOT be answered from the notice?
choices: How much is an adult ticket?
What time does the final performance start?
How much does the food on Food Street cost?
Which countries are the traditional costumes from?
questions.answer: How much does the food on Food Street cost?
questions.explanation: 음식 가격 정보는 안내문에 없다.

questions.q: Which is NOT consistent with the notice?
choices: Visitors must bring their own reusable cups to enter the festival.
The festival takes place over a weekend.
Learning greetings is one of the programs.
The Traditional Clothing Experience costs nothing.
Students must show their ID cards at the entrance.
questions.answer: Visitors must bring their own reusable cups to enter the festival.
questions.explanation: 재사용 컵은 권장(encouraged) 사항이지 입장 조건이 아니다.

questions.q: Why are visitors encouraged to bring reusable cups and shopping bags?
questions.explanation: 'to reduce waste' — 쓰레기를 줄이기 위해서이다.

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically INCORRECT?
choices: Pets are not permitted inside the festival grounds.
Enjoy live performances held every two hours.
Students are required present their student ID card.
Collect stamps to receive a free T-shirt.
Experience a journey without ever leaving the city.
questions.answer: Students are required present their student ID card.
questions.explanation: be required 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 한다 → are required to present.

questions.q: 밑줄 친 'held'와 쓰임이 같은 것은? "Enjoy live performances held every two hours."
choices: He has held the record for years.
I read a letter written in English.
They held a party last night.
questions.answer: I read a letter written in English.

questions.q: 'held every two hours'의 의미로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: every + 숫자 + 복수명사 = ~마다. every two hours = 2시간마다.

questions.q: Which is true about the Traditional Clothing Experience?
choices: Visitors must pay extra to take photos.
Only children under 13 can join it.
Visitors can buy costumes from 12 countries.
Visitors can wear costumes from three countries for free.
questions.answer: Visitors can wear costumes from three countries for free.
questions.explanation: 일본·베트남·몽골 세 나라 의상을 무료(Free of charge)로 입고 사진을 찍을 수 있다.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the festival organizers?
choices: They want visitors to bring their pets.
They care about protecting the environment.
They think students should pay more than adults.
They plan to hold the festival every month.
questions.answer: They care about protecting the environment.
questions.explanation: 재사용 컵과 장바구니를 가져와 쓰레기를 줄이라고 권장하는 것에서 환경 보호에 관심이 있음을 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Kevin, 17, wants to get the student price. What should he do?

Buy a ticket for his younger brother
questions.answer: Bring his student ID card and show it at the entrance

essays.q: Explain in 2-3 English sentences why the festival says visitors can "experience a journey around the globe without ever leaving the city." Mention at least three programs.
essays.sampleAnswer: Visitors can experience many cultures in one place in Daegu. They can sample dishes from 12 countries, try on traditional costumes from Japan, Vietnam, and Mongolia, and learn greetings in five languages. So it feels like traveling around the world.
essays.rubric: ① 한 도시에서 다양한 문화 체험 ② 프로그램 3개 이상 ③ 영어 2~3문장, 문법 정확성

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 'Visitors are strongly encouraged to bring their own reusable cups'와 'Students are required to present their student ID card'의 차이를 의무 여부 관점에서 설명하시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: be encouraged to는 '~하도록 권장된다'는 뜻으로 꼭 지켜야 하는 것은 아니다. be required to는 '~해야 한다'는 뜻으로 반드시 지켜야 하는 의무이다. 따라서 재사용 컵은 선택이지만 학생증 제시는 필수이다.
essays.rubric: ① be encouraged to = 권장(선택) ② be required to = 의무(필수) ③ 본문 내용에 적용

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '학생들은 입구에서 학생증을 제시해야 한다.' <조건> require를 수동태로 쓰고 present를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Students are required to present their student ID card at the entrance.
essays.rubric: ① are required to ② present ③ student ID card ④ at the entrance

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '2시간마다 열리는 라이브 공연을 즐기세요.' <조건> 과거분사 held가 performances를 뒤에서 꾸미게 할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Enjoy live performances held every two hours.
essays.rubric: ① 명령문 Enjoy ② live performances ③ held(과거분사 후치수식) ④ every two hours

essays.q: You will visit the festival on Saturday from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Write an English plan (in time order) that includes at least three programs and one music performance at the correct time.
essays.sampleAnswer: At 11:00 a.m., I will try on a traditional costume from Vietnam and take photos. At noon, I will watch the first performance at the World Music Stage. After that, I will sample Turkish kebabs on Food Street. At 2:00 p.m., I will learn basic greetings at the Language Corner.
essays.rubric: ① 시간 순서 ② 프로그램 3개 이상 ③ 공연 시간이 12시 또는 2시로 정확 ④ 영어 문장의 정확성

wordbook.sentence: - Food Street: Sample authentic dishes from 12 different countries, including Mexican tacos, Indian curry, and Turkish kebabs.

prestudy.tagged_body:
Daegu International Culture Festival
{{v:Embark on}} a journey around the globe {{t:without ever departing from the city}}!

Date: Saturday, October 31 – Sunday, November 1
Time: 11:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.
{{v:Venue}}: Duryu Park, Daegu

Programs
- Food Street: {{v:Savor}} authentic {{g:cuisine representing 12 different countries|현재분사 후치수식: representing ~ (= which represents ~)}}, including Mexican tacos, Indian curry, and Turkish kebabs.
- Traditional Clothing Experience: Try on traditional {{v:garments}} from Japan, Vietnam, and Mongolia, and {{v:commemorate}} the experience with photographs. (Complimentary)
- World Music Stage: Enjoy live {{g:performances scheduled at two-hour intervals|과거분사 후치수식 / at two-hour intervals = 2시간 간격으로 (two-hour: 하이픈 형용사는 단수)}}, {{g:commencing at noon|분사구문: (and they commence) at noon}}. The {{v:concluding}} performance begins at 4:00 p.m.
- Language Corner: Acquire fundamental greetings in five different languages.

Admission
- Adults: 8,000 won
- Students (ages 13–18): 5,000 won
- Children under 13: Complimentary admission
※ {{g:Students are required to present|be required to + 동사원형: ~해야 한다}} valid student identification at the entrance.

Special Event
Accumulate stamps from {{v:a minimum of five}} national booths to receive a complimentary festival T-shirt! ({{g:Available exclusively to|형용사구 (which are) available ~: 생략된 주어·be동사}} the first 300 visitors each day)

Please note: Pets are {{v:strictly prohibited}} within the festival {{v:premises}}. Visitors are strongly encouraged to bring their own reusable cups and shopping bags {{g:in order to minimize waste|in order to + 동사원형: ~하기 위해 (목적)}}.

questions.q: Which best describes the purpose of the notice?
choices: To report on the success of a past cultural festival
To recruit performers for the World Music Stage
To publicize a multicultural festival and inform visitors of its programs, fees, and rules
To persuade students to study foreign languages
To announce the closing of Duryu Park
questions.answer: To publicize a multicultural festival and inform visitors of its programs, fees, and rules
questions.explanation: 다문화 축제를 홍보하고 프로그램·요금·규칙을 알리는 안내문이다.

questions.q: In the notice, 'Embark on' is closest in meaning to ____.
questions.explanation: embark on = (여정·일을) 시작하다, 착수하다.

questions.q: What does 'Savor' mean in "Savor authentic cuisine"?
choices: Enjoy the taste of something slowly
questions.answer: Enjoy the taste of something slowly
questions.explanation: savor = 음미하다, (맛을) 천천히 즐기다.

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'commemorate the experience with photographs'?
choices: Delete the photos after the experience
Take photos to remember the experience
Pay for photos of the experience
questions.answer: Take photos to remember the experience
questions.explanation: commemorate = 기념하다. 사진으로 그 경험을 기념하라는 뜻이다.

questions.q: 'performances scheduled at two-hour intervals'의 의미로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: interval = 간격. at two-hour intervals = 2시간 간격으로(= every two hours).

questions.q: Which word can best replace 'concluding' in "The concluding performance begins at 4:00 p.m."?
questions.explanation: concluding = 마지막의, 끝맺는(final).

questions.q: In the notice, 'premises' refers to ____.
choices: the area and buildings of the festival
questions.answer: the area and buildings of the festival
questions.explanation: premises = (건물이 딸린) 부지, 구내. festival premises = 축제 장소.

questions.q: Which is closest in meaning to 'a minimum of five national booths'?
questions.explanation: a minimum of five = 최소 다섯 = at least five.

questions.q: Sean enters the festival at 12:30 p.m. on Saturday and stays until closing. How many performances at the World Music Stage can he see from the beginning?
questions.explanation: 공연은 12시·2시·4시에 시작한다. 12시 30분 이후 처음부터 볼 수 있는 공연은 2시와 4시 두 번이다.

questions.q: A family of two parents, 13-year-old twins, and an 8-year-old daughter visits the festival. What is their total admission fee?
questions.explanation: 성인 8,000원 × 2 + 학생(13~18세) 5,000원 × 2 + 8세 무료 = 26,000원. 13세는 학생 요금 구간에 포함된다.

questions.q: Who is eligible for a complimentary T-shirt?
choices: Noah, the 150th visitor on Sunday, who collected stamps from five national booths
Grace, the 301st visitor on Saturday, who collected stamps from nine booths
Liam, the 20th visitor on Sunday, who collected stamps from four booths
Olivia, who brought a reusable cup but collected no stamps
Ethan, the 500th visitor on Sunday, who collected stamps from six booths
questions.answer: Noah, the 150th visitor on Sunday, who collected stamps from five national booths
questions.explanation: 최소 5개 부스 도장 + 그날 선착순 300명이라는 두 조건을 모두 만족한 사람은 Noah이다.

questions.q: Which statement CANNOT be inferred from the notice?
choices: Some programs require no additional payment.
Visitors cannot see a performance that starts after 4:00 p.m.
A 12-year-old visitor pays no admission fee.
Not every visitor who collects five stamps will get a T-shirt.
Visitors who bring reusable cups receive a ticket discount.
questions.answer: Visitors who bring reusable cups receive a ticket discount.
questions.explanation: 재사용 컵을 가져오면 할인해 준다는 내용은 없다. 나머지는 모두 안내문에서 추론 가능하다.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the organizers' values?
choices: They focus mainly on making a profit.
They aim to host an environmentally responsible event.
They believe pets help visitors relax.
They want visitors to avoid traditional culture.
questions.answer: They aim to host an environmentally responsible event.
questions.explanation: in order to minimize waste처럼 쓰레기를 줄이려는 노력에서 친환경 축제를 지향함을 알 수 있다.

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically INCORRECT?
choices: Pets are strictly prohibited within the festival premises.
Enjoy live performances scheduled at two-hour intervals.
Students are required presenting valid student identification.
Bring reusable bags in order to minimize waste.
questions.answer: Students are required presenting valid student identification.
questions.explanation: be required 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 한다 → are required to present.

questions.q: Which is the correct paraphrase of "Savor authentic cuisine representing 12 different countries"?
choices: Savor authentic cuisine which is represented 12 different countries.
Savor authentic cuisine which represents 12 different countries.
Savor authentic cuisine who represents 12 different countries.
Savor authentic cuisine represented 12 different countries.
Savor authentic cuisine that representing 12 different countries.
questions.answer: Savor authentic cuisine which represents 12 different countries.
questions.explanation: 현재분사 representing은 '관계대명사 + 동사(which represents)'로 바꿀 수 있다. 능동 관계이므로 과거분사는 쓸 수 없다.

questions.q: Which uses 'in order to' in the same way as "in order to minimize waste"?
choices: The books are in order on the shelf.
He gave an order to the waiter.
In order, the students entered the hall.
She woke up early in order to catch the first bus.
The machine is out of order.
questions.answer: She woke up early in order to catch the first bus.
questions.explanation: in order to + 동사원형 = ~하기 위해서(목적).

questions.q: Why is 'two-hour' used instead of 'two-hours' in "at two-hour intervals"?
choices: Because hour is an uncountable noun.
Because intervals is a singular noun.
Because a hyphenated number-noun used as an adjective takes the singular form.
Because two is not a plural number.
Because the word hour starts with a silent h.
questions.answer: Because a hyphenated number-noun used as an adjective takes the singular form.
questions.explanation: 숫자-명사가 하이픈으로 연결되어 형용사로 쓰일 때는 단수형을 쓴다 (a five-year-old boy, a ten-dollar bill).

questions.q: Which is the most appropriate title for the notice?
choices: A World Tour in Your Own City: Daegu Welcomes Every Culture
How to Travel Abroad on a Small Budget
Duryu Park Closes for the Weekend
Rules for Owning Pets in Daegu
Learn Five Languages in Two Days
questions.answer: A World Tour in Your Own City: Daegu Welcomes Every Culture
questions.explanation: 도시 안에서 세계 여러 문화를 체험하는 축제라는 내용을 가장 잘 담은 제목이다.

items: Accumulate a stamp at each booth.
Present valid student identification at the entrance.
Claim a complimentary festival T-shirt.
Pay the student admission fee of 5,000 won.
Visit a minimum of five national booths.
answer: Present valid student identification at the entrance.
Pay the student admission fee of 5,000 won.
Visit a minimum of five national booths.
Accumulate a stamp at each booth.
Claim a complimentary festival T-shirt.

essays.q: Summarize the notice in three English sentences: (1) what, when, and where, (2) the main programs, and (3) the key rules for visitors.
essays.sampleAnswer: The Daegu International Culture Festival will be held at Duryu Park from October 31 to November 1. Visitors can enjoy food from 12 countries, traditional garments, live music, and basic greetings in five languages. Students must show their ID cards, pets are prohibited, and visitors are encouraged to bring reusable cups and bags.
essays.rubric: ① 행사명·날짜·장소 ② 주요 프로그램 ③ 규칙(학생증·애완동물·재사용품) ④ 영어 3문장, 정확성

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 안내문에서 'Complimentary'가 쓰인 곳을 모두 찾아 무엇이 무료인지 쓰고, '(Available exclusively to the first 300 visitors each day)'의 의미와 이에 따른 티셔츠 최대 지급 수를 설명하시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 무료인 것: ① 전통 의상 체험 ② 13세 미만 어린이 입장 ③ 도장 5개 이상 모은 사람의 축제 티셔츠. 괄호 문장은 '매일 선착순 300명에게만 제공된다'는 뜻이므로, 이틀 동안 최대 600장이 지급될 수 있다.
essays.rubric: ① 무료 항목 3가지 ② exclusively = 오직 ~에게만, each day = 매일 ③ 300 × 2 = 600장

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '12개의 다른 나라를 대표하는 정통 요리를 음미하세요.' <조건> savor와 현재분사 representing을 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Savor authentic cuisine representing 12 different countries.
essays.rubric: ① 명령문 Savor ② authentic cuisine ③ representing(현재분사 후치수식) ④ 12 different countries

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오. '방문객들은 쓰레기를 최소화하기 위해 재사용 가능한 컵을 가져오도록 강력히 권장된다.' <조건> be encouraged to, in order to를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Visitors are strongly encouraged to bring reusable cups in order to minimize waste.
essays.rubric: ① are (strongly) encouraged to bring ② reusable cups ③ in order to minimize waste ④ 의미 일치

essays.q: Some people argue that festivals should completely ban disposable cups and bags instead of only encouraging visitors to bring reusable ones. Do you agree? Write your opinion in English with two reasons.
essays.sampleAnswer: I agree that festivals should ban disposable cups and bags. First, large festivals produce a huge amount of waste in just a few days, and simply encouraging visitors is often not enough. Second, a clear rule would make visitors form eco-friendly habits that they can continue in daily life. However, organizers should also provide cups for rent so that visitors are not inconvenienced.
essays.rubric: ① 입장 명확 ② 근거 2개 ③ 논리적 연결어(First, Second, However 등) ④ 영어 문장의 정확성
